He now has to work out projected times for athletes that range from 10 year old Louise Collier to septuagenarian Charlie Manning, from "come-back" specialist Vic Butcher to flying Moroccan Najibe Hliouat.

The rise in standard was not restricted to the senior women's team for Debbie Hearn was our highest placed runner of the afternoon when she came home 3rd in the under 17 race and Louise Collier and Genya Marek ensured that we were well represented in each of the other age groups.
Down in the youngest age group Louise Collier improved to 6th and with a couple more years in the same category is surely one of our stars for the future.
